input.replyBody:
Hi Ava,

Sorry about the double charge. You're right: your monthly renewal this morning charged your card twice for $29.99. A retry on our billing side caused it. Nothing you did made it happen.

We will refund the extra $29.99 charge once a team member approves it. Depending on your bank, it can take a few business days to show on your statement. Your subscription stays active, and the other $29.99 charge covers this month's renewal. We will also hand the cause to our tech team with the details.

You don't need to do anything. If the refund doesn't show up within about a week, just reply here.

Best,
PawPlan Support
